command:
set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=e5eef6b97bef9a1e7b0f3b3146e4a73dd86c166b; git fetch --quiet origin main; git reset --hard "$EXPECTED"; git clean -fd; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"; echo '=== SERIAL ENUMERATION (READ ONLY) ==='; ls -l /dev/cu.usbmodem* 2>/dev/null || true; ls -l /dev/cu.usbserial* 2>/dev/null || true; USBINFO=$(ioreg -p IOUSB -l -w 0); printf '%s\n' "$USBINFO" | grep -q '40:4C:CA:5D:0A:00'; printf '%s\n' "$USBINFO" | grep -q 'USB JTAG_serial debug unit'; printf '%s\n' "$USBINFO" | grep -q '"idVendor" = 12346'; printf '%s\n' "$USBINFO" | grep -q '"idProduct" = 4097'; printf '%s\n' "$USBINFO" | grep -q '"idVendor" = 6790'; printf '%s\n' "$USBINFO" | grep -q '"idProduct" = 29987'; PORT=$(python3 - <<'PY'
import glob,sys
ports=glob.glob('/dev/cu.usbmodem*')
if len(ports)!=1:
    print('Expected exactly one native usbmodem C6 candidate, got: '+repr(ports), file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(2)
print(ports[0])
PY
); case "$PORT" in /dev/cu.usbmodem*) ;; *) echo 'Refusing non-usbmodem port' >&2; exit 3;; esac; test "$PORT" != '/dev/cu.usbserial-1130'; test -e /dev/cu.usbserial-1130; echo "C6_PORT=$PORT"; printf '%s\n' "$PORT" > /tmp/c6_final_port.txt; . ~/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh >/dev/null; grep -q '^CONFIG_IDF_TARGET="esp32c6"' sdkconfig; idf.py build; grep -q 'e5eef6b' build/project_description.json || true; test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"
